_comment: Landfall 2026-10-15: the SEARCHED LAND-DROP TIMING axis (Plan::land_after_casts). Seven untapped
Forests, six old (non-sick) 0/1 Plant tokens, opponent at 6, hand Avenger of Zendikar + Forest,
resumed at main 1. Exact lethal T7: CAST AVENGER FIRST (seven Forests), THEN play the Forest --
Avenger's landfall puts a +1/+1 counter on every Plant (it is on the battlefield when the land
enters), and the six old Plants swing for 6. Land-first (the only order before this axis) plays
the Forest, casts Avenger off eight lands, makes eight SICK Plants and no counter: 0 damage, win
T8. So the T7 win needs the land-after plan to be enumerated, applied by both worlds through the
Karoo deferral path, and the landfall dispatch to fire from the land drop (PlayLandFromHand).
Filler = Swords to Plowshares: a dead draw on a mono-Forest board.
